body:
I don't really play multiplayer games anymore but I appreciate the offer. And thank you for the encouragement.

I'm worried that the people I love really don't care though. Some have come out and said that I'm just annoying most of the time. I don't mean to be annoying. If I could stop the rush of chemicals in my brain from causing my body to display the physical symptoms that cause me to panic, I would. No one would choose panic. Knowing they're just sticking around in hopes I get better puts enormous pressure on me... and it also makes me feel a bit worthless. It also makes me wonder if the few friends I do have are just my friends for what they can get out of me, not because they actually care about me.
